project_overview: CCTNS是一个为警察部门设计的案件管理系统，提供案件注册、调查、起诉、搜索等功能，并支持多语言界面和离线模式。

functions.name: ConfigureSystem
acceptance_criteria: 配置信息能够正确保存
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有管理员权限

functions.name: NavigateSystem
acceptance_criteria: 页面能够根据用户角色正确显示
导航信息能够实时更新

constraints.description: 系统必须为所有用户界面上的所有可能操作和场景提供详细的上下文相关帮助材料
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

constraints.description: 系统必须提供界面让用户记录应用程序的缺陷或增强请求并跟踪
constraints.source_text: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够发送警报（如电子邮件、短信）给选择接收的用户
constraints.source_text: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

constraints.description: 系统必须保持不可更改的审计跟踪，自动捕获和存储关键实体的操作信息
constraints.source_text: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word 'unalterable' is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

constraints.description: 系统必须跟踪事件并存储在审计跟踪中，无需人工干预
constraints.source_text: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

constraints.description: 系统必须维护审计跟踪至少与相关案件的寿命一样长
constraints.source_text: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

constraints.description: 系统必须允许用户将案件访问权限限制为特定用户或用户组
constraints.source_text: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

constraints.description: 系统必须仅允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
constraints.source_text: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

constraints.description: 系统必须确保所有错误消息都是有意义的，用户可以采取适当行动
constraints.source_text: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

constraints.description: 系统必须支持多语言界面
constraints.source_text: The system should support multilingual interface

constraints.description: 系统必须使用HTTPS作为通信协议
constraints.source_text: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)

constraints.description: 系统必须支持选择性加密存储数据
constraints.source_text: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

constraints.description: 系统必须防止跨站脚本攻击
constraints.source_text: Prevent cross-site scripting

constraints.description: 系统必须防止SQL注入
constraints.source_text: Prevent SQL Injection

constraints.description: 系统不得允许硬删除，只能进行软标记删除
constraints.source_text: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

constraints.description: 系统必须能够在离线模式下工作并提供关键功能
constraints.source_text: The system should work even in an offline mode with the critical functionality

constraints.description: 系统必须设计为即使在低带宽连接的警察局也能提供满意的性能
constraints.source_text: The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth

constraints.description: 系统必须实现服务导向架构(SOA)并具有模块化设计
constraints.source_text: The system should be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and have a modular design

constraints.description: 系统必须支持多浏览器运行
constraints.source_text: The system should run on multiple browsers
